title: Go III Professional: Taikyoku Igo
overview: Go III Professional: Taikyoku Igo is a digital conversion of the ancient Chinese board game Go, part of a series of such games produced by Oxford Softworks. Like the previous release, this version offers play against 12 different CPU skill levels or a second player, options for 9x9, 13x13, and 19x19 game boards, handicap options, Chinese or Japanese rule variations, and a variety of board graphic options. New in this version is the option to set turn time limits for each player.
